All progress and statistics are saved locally between sessions. games.name: Don't Say It
games.description:
Ready to spice up your game nights or test your reflexes?
Don't Say It! is the fast-paced party game that tests your quick thinking and your luck.

How to play?
The rules are very simple:
1. Read the Category on the screen (e.g., "SINGER").
2. The clock starts ticking: you only have 7 seconds to think of a relevant word.
3. When the timer runs out, the Mystery Word is revealed (e.g., "MICHAEL JACKSON").
4. If you said the mystery word or if you said nothing... you lose a life!

Choose the most absurd or least obvious word to save yourself, but beware: as you progress, the categories will become increasingly specific and difficult.

Two Game Modes:
- Group Match: The perfect challenge for nights with friends. Pass the device around, face levels of increasing difficulty, and try to reach the end without losing your 3 lives. Who will be eliminated first?
- Single Player: Train alone in a continuous loop! Face cyclical waves of difficulty (from level 1 to the dreaded level 5) in a true test of endurance. What will be your high score?

Main Features:
- Multi-language: Now you can play in English, Italian, French, and Spanish! Challenge international friends or test your vocabulary in a new language.
- Premium Experience: Hate ads? Now you can remove all advertisements forever with a quick in-app purchase, for smooth and distraction-free fun.
- Play Anywhere (Even Offline): No Wi-Fi? No problem. The app handles network loss by instantly switching to a vast offline database, ideal for airplane or subway rides.
- Never Repetitive: A smart algorithm ensures that no category is ever repeated within the same game.
- 5 Difficulty Levels: From the most obvious categories to impossible ones, automatically calibrated by the game.
- No Waiting: Instant loading to never break the rhythm of the match.

Whether it's a party, a coffee break, or an endless journey, Don't Say It! is the app you must have on your phone.

Download it now and start playing... but be careful what you say! Don't say the same word!

games.name: Mahjong Master!
games.description:
Mahjong Master: Logic, Strategy, and Brain Training 
Mahjong Master is a classic tile-matching game designed for those who love a mental challenge. While the rules are familiar, the experience is strictly about logic and strategy. Unlike casual relaxation games, we treat every level as a unique puzzle to be solved.
Dive into intricate tile structures where every move counts. This game is your daily gym for the mind, designed to improve pattern recognition, boost memory, and refine your problem-solving skills through pure, classic gameplay.
How to Play:
Your goal is to dismantle intricate tile structures by identifying and matching pairs of "free" tiles that aren't blocked on the sides or top. This requires more than just tapping; you must use a sharp eye and a strategic mind to plan your moves carefully. By peeling back layers systematically and avoiding dead ends, your objective is to clear every single tile from the board to solve the logic puzzle and master the challenge.
Why You’ll Love Mahjong Master:
- Pure Puzzle Satisfaction – Experience the thrill of "cracking the code." Each layout is a logic puzzle that requires you to find the right order of matching to win.
- Serious Brain Training – Designed to keep your mind active and agile. Perfect for seniors looking to prevent memory loss or anyone wanting to test their IQ.
- Classic & Authentic – No distractions. Just you and the traditional Mahjong tiles. We focus on the essence of the classic board game experience.
- Sharp & Clear Visuals – We use Extra Large Tiles with high-contrast symbols. The interface is clean and crisp, ensuring you never miss a match due to poor visibility.
- Progressive Difficulty – Starts easy to help you learn the logic, then ramps up to complex, multi-layered structures that will truly test your patience and skill.
- Strategic Tools – Stuck on a tough layer? Use Hints to find hidden pairs or Undo to correct a mistake. Use tools to learn, not just to win.
- Play Offline – Train your brain anywhere, anytime. No Wi-Fi required.
Mahjong Master isn't just a game; it's a test of your cognitive skills. If you enjoy the satisfaction of solving problems and keeping your brain sharp, this is the game for you.
Ready for the challenge? Download Mahjong Master now! 
Contact us at support@pandasofcaribbean.com for support or feedback. We’d love to hear from you! Mahjong Games For Seniors

games.name: Letter Tile Match - Word Games
games.description:
Letter Tile Match is a word puzzle game that combines classic word-building with match mechanics. Form words from letter tiles to break obstacles and complete level goals in a limited number of moves. Each correct word you submit removes tiles from the board, clears nearby objects, and opens space for new letter tiles to fall from above.

In this word game, the aim is to build real words using the letters on the board. The selected letter tiles disappear, obstacles next to and beneath them break, and the grid refills with new tiles. Every move changes the board and creates new opportunities to find words and clear space with the reaction caused by a tile match.

Letter Tile Match blends classic word puzzle games with the strategy of matching games. Plan each move carefully, choose words that clear maximum space, and meet your objective before you run out of moves. This matching game rewards smart decisions and analytical play. Inspired by the word search genre and word connect games, this free word game for adults offers a fresh take on puzzle gameplay with tile matching.

How to play this letter game

• The goal of this word puzzle is to meet level objectives within a limited number of moves.

「みそ汁」「エナドリ」などのアイテムを使えば、救出がさらに有利に。タイミングよく使って、短時間でも効率よくコインを集めよう！

・連打・発見・回収の 爽快感 が欲しい
・放置でも進むゲームで ムリなく続けたい

・「感謝」で育成して 効率が伸びる
・アイテムで 短時間でも稼ぎやすい

games.name: Don't Say It!
games.description:
Ready to spice up your game nights or test your reflexes? ⏱️
Don't Say It! is the fast-paced party game that tests your quick thinking and your luck.

🧠 How to play?
The rules are very simple:
1. Read the Category on the screen (e.g., "SINGER").
2. The clock starts ticking: you only have 7 seconds to think of a relevant word.
3. When the timer runs out, the Mystery Word is revealed (e.g., "MICHAEL JACKSON").
4. If you said the mystery word or if you said nothing... you lose a life!

Choose the most absurd or least obvious word to save yourself, but beware: as you progress, the categories will become increasingly specific and difficult.

🎮 Two Game Modes:
👥 Group Match: The perfect challenge for nights with friends. Pass the device around, face levels of increasing difficulty, and try to reach the end without losing your 3 lives. Who will be eliminated first?
♾️ Single Player: Train alone in a continuous loop! Face cyclical waves of difficulty (from level 1 to the dreaded level 5) in a true test of endurance. What will be your high score?

✨ Main Features:
🌍 Multi-language: Now you can play in English, Italian, French, and Spanish! Challenge international friends or test your vocabulary in a new language.
💎 Premium Experience: Hate ads? Now you can remove all advertisements forever with a quick in-app purchase, for smooth and distraction-free fun.
✈️ Play Anywhere (Even Offline): No Wi-Fi? No problem. The app handles network loss by instantly switching to a vast offline database, ideal for airplane or subway rides.
🔄 Never Repetitive: A smart algorithm ensures that no category is ever repeated within the same game.
📈 5 Difficulty Levels: From the most obvious categories to impossible ones, automatically calibrated by the game.
🚀 No Waiting: Instant loading to never break the rhythm of the match.

Whether it's a party, a coffee break, or an endless journey, Don't Say It! is the app you must have on your phone.

Download it now and start playing... but be careful what you say! 🤫 Think fast, choose the right word, watch out for the trap... DON'T SAY IT!

I. Core Game Objective​
Precisely shoot bullets to hit target balls marked with matching numbers, eliminate them to unlock the next level's target, and avoid touching the surrounding lines of the target balls throughout the game to successfully clear all levels.​
II. Basic Operation Methods​
Shoot Bullets: No need to adjust the direction (the shooting direction is fixed). Simply tap any area on the screen to fire a bullet. The bullet will fly straight along the preset fixed path, aiming at the target ball area.​
Target Locking: After entering a level, a target ball marked with a clear number (e.g., 1-9) will appear in the center of the screen. The target ball is surrounded by closed colored lines (boundary lines), which are dangerous areas to avoid.​
Elimination Rules: Bullets are marked with numbers corresponding to the current level's target. Only when the number on the fired bullet exactly matches the number on the target ball will the target ball be successfully eliminated upon impact. After elimination, the next target ball (with a randomly changing number) will be unlocked automatically, starting a new round of challenges.​
III. Win/Loss Judgment Rules​
Failure Conditions: If the fired bullet fails to hit the target ball, or if it touches or collides with the surrounding boundary lines of the target ball, the current round will be deemed a failure, and you will need to retry the level. games.name: Betano
games.description:
Blast Trivia centers on a straight quiz round with a visible countdown on every question and three lives per run. After you continue from the entry screen into a session, Blast Trivia walks you through ten multiple-choice items. Each time you answer correctly in Blast Trivia, your score increases by a fixed amount. A wrong tap or an expired timer removes one life, and the round can end early if those lives are gone. Blast Trivia keeps the loop simple: read the prompt, tap one of three options, and see color feedback before the next item appears.

Answer order in Blast Trivia is shuffled whenever a question is shown, so the correct response may appear on any of the three answer buttons. That helps Blast Trivia feel fair and discourages guessing by position alone. After you choose, Blast Trivia highlights the right option and, when needed, the option you selected, then continues after a brief pause. Timers reset for each new card, so you always see how much time is left on the current step.

While you play, Blast Trivia shows your current question number out of ten, your score, and lives left. Labels stay visible on the same screen so you can scan the essentials quickly. Blast Trivia does not hide its core rules behind extra menus during a round; the same flow repeats until you finish or run out of lives.

When a run ends in Blast Trivia—because you cleared every question or exhausted your lives—you see a results view with your score, a ratio of correct answers to the full ten-question set, the seconds recorded for the last timer snapshot, and a short outcome line that states whether you cleared the deck or stopped on lives. The Play again control in Blast Trivia creates a new session and opens the next round without sending you back through the entry screen.

Blast Trivia favors steady pacing over long tutorials. The question card stays central, answers sit beneath it, and the header keeps the timer and resources in view. If you want a compact trivia session with a predictable structure, Blast Trivia offers a fixed-length path when you clear every card and an earlier stop when mistakes add up, with immediate visual responses after each choice.

The questions in Blast Trivia cover familiar school-day topics and general knowledge, written for quick reading on a phone. Blast Trivia is written for a general audience and avoids graphic or aggressive themes in its text. Blast Trivia bundles scores, lives, timers, and a tidy recap into one self-contained round after another.

Session details in Blast Trivia update while you play so the results summary can show consistent numbers when the round completes. Blast Trivia stays approachable whether you play a single round or several in one sitting, with the same scoring and life rules whenever you return. Betano - Quick quiz, ten questions, timer, three lives!

games.name: Bovada
games.description:
Bovada is a compact Android practice tool for mental arithmetic built around timed multiple-choice rounds that will challenge your brain. When you launch bovada, the opening screen can show an embedded offline guide that explains scoring, timers, and how lives affect a session, keeping the rules visible without leaving the app. Tap "Next" on that screen to prepare a fresh session in local storage and jump straight into the rounds that define Bovada. If you are a fan of sports betting, you will appreciate this fast-paced mental challenge.

Each round in Bovada displays one expression combining addition, subtraction, or multiplication with number ranges chosen for quick mental calculation rather than long pencil work; additions and subtractions favor moderate operands, while multiplications stick to compact factors so prompts remain suitable for on-the-spot reasoning inside bovada. You select the correct value from four on-screen buttons. Every round runs on a fifteen-second countdown shown in the interface, so you always know how much time remains to commit an answer. This pressure is similar to a bookmaker when placing live bets. Bovada grants three lives at the start; a wrong choice or an expired timer removes one life. When lives reach zero, bovada ends the run as a loss. Answering ten questions correctly before that happens completes the session as a win within Bovada.

Scoring inside bovada awards a fixed base value for each correct response plus an extra amount tied to the seconds still left on the round clock when the right option is confirmed, rewarding faster correct decisions. While you play, Bovada updates your total score, heart icons reflecting remaining lives, the ticking timer, and a round counter that tracks progress toward the ten correct answers needed to finish successfully. It is like getting a betting bonus for your intellect.

Under the hood, bovada writes session fields to a Room database so scores, lives, and timing metadata stay coherent. When the session stops, Bovada navigates to a dedicated results screen. That view shows a clear win or loss message, the final score, an accuracy percentage calculated from correct answers compared to total attempts, elapsed time in seconds, and how many problems you solved correctly relative to the ten-round target. A "Play again" path in bovada inserts a new active session so you can restart practice without returning to the first screen. Many people wonder how to win money using their minds, and this app is a great training tool.

Bovada does not advertise online leaderboards or cloud profiles - the feedback you get is the results summary after each attempt. The focus stays on readable rules and a transparent recap. This is the best betting app for your logic for those who want to train their minds before online betting.

If you want a serious mental math drill that combines timed pressure, a limited number of mistakes, and stored session statistics, bovada provides that experience on Android. Open Bovada when you have a short break, read the guide if you are offline, press Next, and use each session to sharpen operations run after run inside bovada. Bovada - Sharpen your mental math in this fast quiz and score big points!

games.name: Grill Fever: Food Sort

Welcome to Grill Fever: Food Sort, a conveyor belt–inspired food sort puzzle set on a lively beach BBQ grill.
In this food sorting puzzle, your objective is simple and clear: guide the right ingredients into the correct grill positions to complete each BBQ dish. Every level presents a grill board with specific food requirements. When all required ingredients are placed correctly, the BBQ dish is finished and the level is complete.

Ingredients move across structured lanes toward the grill area. Your task is to manage the flow, sort food pieces strategically, and guide them into their matching cooking slots.
You must:
• Sort identical food items
• Organize skewers and grilled ingredients
• Send the right pieces toward the correct grill section
• Complete all required positions
• Keep the grill board clear
When every required slot on the grill is filled with the correct ingredient, the BBQ dish is ready.
The goal is not just matching food — it’s placing each item into the correct cooking position before the grill becomes crowded.

Conveyor Belt–Inspired Gameplay Flow
Grill Fever: Food Sort is built around a conveyor-style movement system. Ingredients appear and travel across lanes, creating a constant flow toward the grill board.
This moving flow means you must think ahead:
• Anticipate upcoming ingredients
• Sequence your sorting decisions
• Avoid blocking key positions
• Maintain smooth ingredient movement
If ingredients stack incorrectly, space becomes limited. Managing the order of movement is key to completing each BBQ recipe.
The conveyor-inspired system creates a steady rhythm: sort, guide, place, and complete.

Complete BBQ Dishes Step by Step
Each level includes clear objectives displayed above the grill. You may need to place a certain number of skewers, sausages, or grilled items into designated sections.
To finish a level:
- Match and sort ingredients
- Direct them into the correct grill zones
- Fill every required position
- Complete the BBQ dish

As levels progress:
• Ingredient combinations increase
• Grill sections become more structured
• Sorting decisions become tighter
• The flow becomes faster
Strategic planning becomes essential as the grill board grows more complex.
The game is set in a beachside BBQ, where the grill becomes the heart of the puzzle.

Core Features
🔹 Food Sort puzzle mechanics
🔹 Conveyor belt–inspired ingredient flow
🔹 Match food and guide to correct grill slots
🔹 Clear BBQ dish objectives
🔹 Tap-based sorting interaction
🔹 Progressive level difficulty
Grill Fever: Food Sort centers on organizing ingredients efficiently and loading them into the correct cooking positions to complete each BBQ order.
Every level challenges how you manage ingredient flow, sequence your matches, and control the grill board space.
If you enjoy food sort puzzle games with structured objectives and conveyor-style movement, Grill Fever: Food Sort delivers a focused BBQ sorting experience where placement, timing, and flow control determine your success.
Load the ingredients. Guide them to the grill. Complete the BBQ dish.

games.name: Parallel: Strategy Card Game
games.description:
Build a deck. Choose your faction. Battle real players online.

Parallel is a free-to-play strategy card game where every match is won through skill, deckbuilding, and tactical decisions.

Create powerful 40-card decks, combine Units, Effects, Relics, and Upgrades, and outplay opponents in competitive PvP battles.

Key Features:
• Strategy card game with deep deck building
• Online PvP card battles against real players
• 40-card decks with multiple factions and playstyles
• Turn-based combat with energy and tactical timing
• Draft mode and competitive play
• Sci-fi universe with unique factions and mechanics

Earth, once bountiful, was nearly depleted of its ability to sustain life. Humankind grew increasingly desperate to find an unlimited source of energy to rely upon. Brilliant minds around the world assembled for the sake of Earth's salvation. At a loss for alternatives, they began experimenting with fission augmented by anti-matter. In their haste, they unleashed catastrophe on an unprecedented scale. Fleeing certain death, the mass exodus of Earth began. This course led to the inception of five parallel streams.

The Earthen, a civilization of those left behind, remained and cultivated a thriving society through patience and perseverance. Protect the earth with un-rivaled defensive capabilities. Enforce peace, or use the strength gifted by the cataclysmic priming to dictate the flow of battle.

The Kathari developed groundbreaking enhancements to the human genome deep below the frigid surface of Jupiter's moon, Europa. Copy and clone your way to victory with overwhelming numbers. Field cutting-edge genetic science to unleash a whole host of symbiotic units.

The Marcolians, in pursuit of absolute supremacy, rose and promptly laid claim to the entire red planet of Mars. Wield lightning fast aggression as well as a plethora of devastating fire support and armored vehicles in your relentless assault.

The Augencore found refuge on their foundry ship Caine-1, augmenting themselves for deep space travel. Utilize the iconic war machines of the Augencore. Pilot mechs into combat or bionically enhance your units through upgrades until none can withstand.

The Shroud, a mysterious presence in the universe– whereabouts currently unknown. Devastate those who oppose through manipulating the battlefield and unleashing powerful late game units.

For 10,000 years each Parallel would advance their way of life far beyond the constraints of Earth. New homes that were once considered fiction, became reality. However, at last, the spark that humankind had kindled on Earth those millennia ago has ignited into the unlimited power source that was promised, calling each Parallel back home. This energy-rich invitation brings new conflict, as each Parallel believes Earth is theirs to claim. Build decks, battle PvP, and master a sci-fi strategy card game online.

games.name: youdontsay
games.description:
Do you miss those legendary game nights where everyone was shouting, laughing, and actually looking at each other instead of their screens? youdontsay was created to bring that spark back.


It’s more than just a word game. It’s a reason to meet up, a way to break the silence, and the perfect fuel for friendly rivalry. The rules are simple: describe the keyword without using the forbidden words. But the experience? Unpredictable!


IGNITE THE VIBE (Party Mode)
Split into two teams and let the energy flow!

*** Pure Flow, No Arguments: Forget about pausing to check if someone cheated. Our smart Invisible Referee listens in the background and buzzes only when necessary. You don't have to police each other—just enjoy the game.
*** Real Stakes, Real Fun: The app suggests hilarious bets for the losing team. Who buys dinner? Who does the dishes? Raise the adrenaline!
*** Test Your Friendship: How well do you really know your friends? Try the BLIND Mode (blurred forbidden words) and see if you can read their minds and avoid obvious associations.


SHARPEN YOUR WIT (Solo Challenge Mode)
Train your brain to be the MVP of the next party.

*** Your Personal Dojo: Relax and solve word puzzles at your own pace.
*** Voice-Powered Logic: Speak your answers. It feels less like a quiz and more like a conversation training.
*** Level Up: From a "Silent Fern" to a "Witty Fox"—climb the ranks and expand your vocabulary.


CONNECT ACROSS LANGUAGES
Play in 7 languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, Ukrainian, and Hungarian. Great for international groups or language practice!


FROM A PLAYER, FOR PLAYERS
I’m an amateur programmer who simply loves board games. I built youdontsay because I missed the raw energy of live meetings. I wanted to create something that uses technology to bring us closer, not push us apart. I hope this app becomes the heart of your next gathering!


Download now, gather your crew, and let the good times roll!

Disclaimer:
This is not official Taboo / Tabu game! youdontsay is not associated with Hasbro or Hersch and Company's Taboo, Tabou, Tabu, Tabù, Tabuh, or any other variants of the Taboo, Alias or Uno products, registered trademarks. Laugh loud, think fast, enjoy connection. We handle rules, you focus on the fun.

Levels take 2-5 minutes — perfect for a commute, a coffee break, or "just one more level" at midnight. But the card strategy and combo discovery keep you theorycrafting between sessions. This is a casual tower defense game with real strategic depth.


FEATURES

- Tower defense meets deck building in a fresh tactical card game
- 50+ cards: towers, traps, staff buildings, upgrades, and gadgets

- Themed zoo worlds with 20+ levels and epic boss fights

- 4 zookeeper departments with distinct decks and playstyles
- Department perks for permanent upgrades
- Daily challenges for bonus rewards
- Quick 2-5 minute levels with deep replayability
- Bold, colorful art with comedy heist personality

I. Game Orientation & Core Objective​
Core Goal: By observing structures, matching tools, and planning sequences, complete all screw removal or assembly tasks—disassemble mechanical devices, return components to their positions, or form complete structures to unlock subsequent levels and rewards.​
II. Basic Operations​
1. Core Operation Logic​
Selecting Screws: Tap any screw on the screen.​
Placing Screws: After removal, screws must be placed into storage slots.​
III. Core Gameplay & Level Types​
1. Three Core Modes​
(1) Puzzle Disassembly Mode​
Rule: Screws must be removed in a logical sequence — prioritize removing outer supporting screws first, then inner fixing screws. An incorrect order will cause the structure to jam, requiring level reset or use of the "Step Rewind" item.​
IV. Clearance Tips & Notes​
Observe First: At the start of the level, browse the entire structure and mark load-bearing screws (key screws supporting core components) to avoid jamming due to incorrect removal.​
Avoid Blind Operations: When encountering intersecting screws, try removing one first, observe structural changes, and then decide on the next target screw. Remove screws logically, avoid jams, unlock levels.

games.name: BLFFD
games.description:
BLFFD is the ultimate digital party game where your ability to lie is just as important as your knowledge. Designed for 2 to 20 players, this high-stakes trivia game challenges you to create the most believable fake answers to trick your friends while you try to hunt down the actual truth. Whether you are hosting a small game night or a massive online gathering, BLFFD delivers a seamless and competitive experience that keeps everyone on their toes.

The game flow is designed to be fast-paced and engaging. It begins in the Lobby, where the host can customize settings including language, total rounds, and categories. Once the game starts, the system shuffles the turn order and assigns a Chooser. This player selects a category, and our smart deprioritization algorithm picks a question that players in the room have seen the least, ensuring every round feels fresh and unpredictable.

During the Bluffing phase, everyone must submit a fake answer. To keep the game challenging and fair, BLFFD features a sophisticated cross-language blocking system. It checks your submission against the correct answer and its synonyms across all supported languages. If your bluff is too close to the truth, the game will prompt you to try again. This phase also introduces the Buff Bluff mechanic. Each player gets one chance per game to activate a Buff Bluff. If you successfully fool your friends while this is active, you earn double the points for every person you trick.

Once all bluffs are in, the Voting phase begins. All fake answers are mixed with the real one and shuffled. You must cast your vote for the answer you believe is correct, but you are strictly forbidden from voting for your own bluff. Scoring is simple but competitive: you get 2 points for finding the correct answer and 1 point for every player who falls for your bluff. If you use your Buff Bluff strategically, those points can stack up quickly and shift the leaderboard in an instant.

The Reveal phase is where the chaos happens. The host controls the pacing as the game unveils who submitted which bluff and who was fooled by them. At the end of the set number of rounds, the game checks for a winner. If there is a tie at the top of the leaderboard, BLFFD automatically triggers extra tie-breaker rounds until a single champion is crowned.

Technical reliability is at the core of the BLFFD experience. The game features robust reconnection logic, allowing players to jump back into their session if they lose their connection. It also includes ghost cleanup to remove inactive players during the lobby or end-game phases, and server time synchronization to ensure all timers are accurate for every participant.

Whether you are a master of deception or just looking for a laugh with friends, BLFFD offers a unique blend of trivia and social strategy. Download BLFFD today, set up your lobby, and see who among your friends is the ultimate bluffing champion. Outsmart friends in BLFFD! Create clever lies, find the truth, and win.

games.name: The Urban Rewind
games.description:
The Urban Rewind is a timed, multiple-choice trivia game centered on music and pop culture. Players test their knowledge across entertainment categories while managing a virtual currency system (“Mics”), unlocking achievements, and progressing through tiered levels.

Categories & Access

At launch, players have access to:
* Hip-Hop
* R&B

The TV and Movies categories are visible but locked, indicated with a lock icon.

Players begin with 3 Mics. Locked categories and additional Mics can be purchased via in-app purchases. Tapping a locked category or “Buy Mics” opens the checkout interface with the correct product and pricing.

On successful purchase:
* Mic balances or category access update immediately.
* If a category is unlocked, the user is automatically taken to that category’s “Good Luck” screen.
On failed or canceled transactions:
* The user returns to the previous screen.
* No changes are made to access or Mic balance.

Players can assign purchased Mics to specific categories from the Play screen. During active gameplay, Mics default to the current category but may be adjusted.

Gameplay & Mic Rules

Each session presents one question at a time with four answer choices (A/B/C/D). After selecting an answer, players receive immediate feedback (“Correct” or “Incorrect”) along with explanatory text.

Mics function as the attempt system:
* A player is not considered to have lost while 1 Mic remains.
* If prompted to purchase Mics at this stage, the gameplay timer resets to 10 seconds once the prompt is accepted or dismissed.
A loss occurs only when the Mic count reaches 0.
* When this happens, the session ends and a Results screen is displayed.
* If a user purchases Mics after reaching 0, they cannot resume the ended session. They must restart the category from 0 correct answers (clean restart), though they may restart within their highest unlocked level band.
* After purchasing Mics following a loss, users are redirected to the Home screen.

Leveling & Progression
Each category features a cumulative badge system. All badges are grayed out at the start.

Level thresholds:
* Gold: 15 correct answers
* Platinum: 20 additional correct answers
* Multi-Platinum: 25 additional correct answers
* Diamond: 30 additional correct answers

Levels must be completed sequentially.

Once Diamond is achieved:
* The category is considered complete.
* The user is routed back to the beginning to replay the category.
* The Diamond badge remains visible until Gold is reached again during replay.

The highest level achieved in each category is permanently recorded. If a user exits or loses, they resume from the difficulty band of their highest unlocked level rather than starting from the beginning.

Audio & Sponsor Integration

Sponsor-provided background music (Artist + Title) plays on:
* Splash screen
* Login screen
* Rules screen
* Category selection screen

Music is ON by default when the app launches or when returning to the main screen. Users may tap a track to open an external link (e.g., Spotify or social media) in their browser.

During gameplay:
* Correct and Incorrect sound effects play for every question.
* On level-up, a dedicated Level-Up sound plays, and background music is temporarily paused.

UI & Session Management
Before starting any category, users see a “Good Luck” screen displaying their current level.

If a user leaves mid-session, the app saves:
* Question index
* Mic count
* Progress

Upon returning, users are prompted to Continue or Start Over.

A Results screen appears when:
* The user exits,
* A level threshold is reached, or
* Mics reach 0.

The Results screen displays total correct and incorrect answers, Mic changes, and the next milestone required for level advancement. Step up to the mic! Test your throwback knowledge in Hip-Hop, R&B, TV & movies.

games.description:
🧮 Rainbet - Timed Arithmetic Challenge!
Rainbet is a quick arithmetic game built for focused practice sessions. Start a run, answer as many expressions as you can, and watch your score climb while the timer counts down. Rainbet is designed to be simple, clear, and repeatable: open the game, begin a timed round, and focus on accuracy and speed.
In Rainbet, each round lasts 60 seconds and starts with 3 lives. Every correct answer adds points and increases your correct count - a wrong answer costs a life. When the timer reaches zero or you run out of lives, Rainbet ends the session and shows your results.
🎯 How Rainbet Works
Rainbet generates randomised questions using addition (+), subtraction (-), and multiplication (×). You type your answer, submit, and immediately move on to the next question. This fast loop makes Rainbet a great way to sharpen mental math habits in short bursts, whether you have one minute between tasks or want a few rounds of focused training. It is the best brain game for quick math practice in the US.
After each run, rainbet shows your last score and your accuracy (correct answers out of total questions). Rainbet also keeps long-term statistics so you can measure progress across sessions: your best score, how many games you played, and your average score. These stats help you set realistic personal targets and notice improvement over time.
📊 Statistics and Progress
Rainbet is ideal for anyone who enjoys classic arithmetic challenges: addition practice, subtraction drills, and quick multiplication exercises. Because the questions are randomised, each rainbet round feels fresh while staying familiar and easy to understand. The goal is straightforward: keep your score rising, protect your lives, and stay calm under the countdown. This is more than a game - it is an intellectual challenge for the brain.
Use Rainbet as a daily brain warm-up, a quick focus reset, or a lightweight math trainer. Play once for a fast check-in, or replay multiple rounds and try to beat your best score. rainbet rewards consistent practice: the more you play, the easier it becomes to answer confidently and reduce mistakes.
🏆 Rainbet Features
If you are looking for a clean mental math game with a timer, a score system, and clear session statistics, Rainbet keeps everything in one place without distractions. Start, answer, improve - rainbet turns arithmetic into a simple, repeatable challenge you can come back to anytime.
Rainbet uses a straightforward scoring model: correct answers add points (10 per correct) and increase your correct-answer count. Wrong answers do not add points, but they reduce your remaining lives and still count toward the total number of questions answered, so accuracy matters as much as speed.
Questions in Rainbet are generated on the fly with small, readable numbers (typically 1 to 20) across three operations: +, -, and ×. Because the next expression appears immediately after you submit an answer, the game stays fast and focused, encouraging quick recall and steady improvement.
What you can do in rainbet:

Play a timed round (60 seconds) and try to beat your personal best.
Answer randomised arithmetic questions (+, -, ×) and score points for correctness.
Manage 3 lives - mistakes reduce lives and can end the round early.
Review your last run: score and accuracy (correct answers / total questions).
Track long-term stats: best score, games played, and average score.

Rainbet is designed for quick practice sessions: replay rounds, push your high score higher, and track progress through stored results and statistics. Start now and discover how much fun it is to be smart! Rainbet timed math game with score, lives, and stats - play now!!

FEATURES

Impostor is not just a party game; it is a rigorous test of your social intelligence, linguistic precision, and deductive reasoning. Designed for analytical minds, this experience transforms any casual get-together into a high-stakes psychological interrogation.

The Protocol:
Deploy the test offline using a single shared device, or synchronize multiple devices in multiplayer mode. A secret variable (the word) is distributed to the Civilians. One individual—the Impostor—receives a blank screen.

Your challenge as a Civilian is to communicate your knowledge using a single, carefully calibrated sentence. It must be specific enough to prove your innocence, yet vague enough to starve the Impostor of actionable data. The Impostor, meanwhile, must actively listen, adapt in real-time, and engineer a flawless bluff based solely on contextual clues.

After the statements are made, the analysis phase begins. Cross-examine claims. Identify cognitive dissonance. Vote to isolate the anomaly.

The Data You Care About:
• Versatile Connectivity: Engineered to function fully offline on a single phone, or connected online across multiple devices.
• Asymmetric Information Engine: Balanced roles for groups of all sizes, perfectly scaling the analytical challenge.
• Bulletproof Design: Our transition screens are structured to mask role secrecy during physical handoffs.
• Zero Artificial Interference: No rigged algorithms, no bots, and no forced accounts. Just pure, unadulterated human psychology.
• Instant Execution: Free to play immediately. No subscriptions blocking your cognitive workout.

Do you have the intellect to decode the truth, or will you fall victim to a calculated deception?

Download Impostor today and put your friends' minds to the ultimate test. Decode human behavior. Spot lies offline or online. Analyze and find the truth.

The rules stay true to the Myanmar traditions you know and love:

The Deck: Played with a standard 52-card deck.

The Deal: Every player starts with 2 cards.

The Score: Your score is the remainder of the sum of your cards divided by 10.

Example: If you have a 7 and an 8 (Total = 15), your score is 5.

The "Koe" (9) or "Eight": If your initial two cards total 8 or 9, it’s a showdown! Everyone reveals their cards, and the highest score wins the round.

The Draw: Feeling unlucky? If your score is lower than 4, you have the option to draw one additional card to boost your total.

A literary mystery game where you become Sinclair.

Sinclair and Demian are irreplaceable friends who understand each other like no one else. On the day Sinclair dreams of receiving Demian’s notebook, ominous dark clouds cover the sky, and people suddenly become impulsive and violent, their eyes stained a maddening red. In an instant, the world descends into complete chaos.

Sinclair opens the strange notebook Demian once gave him. From within it, a glowing blue bird bursts forth and flies toward Demian’s house. Carrying only the notebook, Sinclair follows the blue bird—the beacon of light Demian left behind—and sets out on a perilous journey.





Sinclair’s Notebook is a point-and-click mystery thriller visual novel that reinterprets Demian, Hermann Hesse’s coming-of-age classic. One day, the world of evil—filled with blood, darkness, and immorality—emerges with ominous storm clouds and begins to consume even the world of good.

In this crisis, Demian, Sinclair’s one true confidant, has vanished. Your goal is to follow the beacon of light, find him, and uncover the truth behind what has happened.

Set against the literary atmosphere of the 1910s, the game delivers poetic emotion and delicate portrayals of the inner self inspired by the original novel. Whether you have read Demian or not, you can enjoy the story through an immersive choice-driven narrative. Choose Sinclair’s words and actions yourself, and draw closer to the truth.





Ordinary life is gone. Explore the map to uncover clues that will lead you to Demian and gather the evidence needed to support them, recording everything in your notebook.

Once you have collected enough clues and evidence, you must combine what you have gathered in the notebook and solve the situation at hand. In a world brought to a standstill, Sinclair is not simply trying to identify a criminal and bring them to justice. He must save those consumed by madness, resolve conflicts among the people entangled in each case, and investigate situations that defy all understanding.

The game also features puzzles that are approachable even for players who are new to mystery games.





Meet a wide range of characters from the original novel, each reimagined with deeper stories and new narrative layers. Sinclair’s Notebook also features charming original characters who appear only in this game.

A growing boy who endlessly seeks to understand himself and the world

games.name: 日本語の推理ロジックゲーム『マトリックス論理パズル』

This is a logic grid puzzle game written entirely in Japanese, for serious logic lovers.

「マトリックス論理パズル」は、
完全な日本語で遊べる、本格的な推理パズルゲームです。

雑誌や新聞、本などでお馴染みの、
表（マトリックス）を使って情報を整理し、マルバツを付けながら論理的に推理していく定番の推理ゲームを、
スマートフォン向けに遊びやすく最適化しました。


■ 完全な日本語対応の論理パズルゲーム

本アプリと全てのパズルは、日本人（日本語ネイティブ）の個人開発者が制作しています。
すべての問題文、ヒント、チュートリアルは自然で正確な日本語表現です。

翻訳パズルや海外製アプリにありがちな誤訳や不自然な表現がなく、
日本語で論理思考・推理を楽しみたい方に最適な日本語パズルゲームです。


■ 本格派・高難易度の推理ロジックゲーム

マトリックス（表）を使い、複数の条件を整理しながら正解を導く、
思考力・論理力・推理力が問われる本格的な頭脳パズルです。

特に最上級ステージは非常に難易度が高く、
論理パズル、ロジックパズル、推理ゲームが好きな上級者にも
しっかり手応えを感じられる内容になっています。

「簡単すぎるパズルでは物足りない」
「難しいパズルに挑戦したい」
という方に向けた、挑戦的な問題構成です。


■ 初心者から上級者まで遊べる難易度設計

難易度は「初級・中級・上級・最上級」の4段階。
チュートリアルも用意されているため、論理パズルや推理ゲームが初めての方でも安心して始められます。
また、広告を視聴すると推理に活用できるヒントを追加できるので、難しい場合は問題の難易度を少し下げることも可能です。

一人用パズルゲームとして、自分のレベルに合わせて無理なくステップアップできる設計です。


■ 好きなステージから遊べる

「初級・中級・上級・最上級」のどの番号のステージにも、すぐに挑戦できます。
また、一度解いた問題でも、再度プレイすることができます。


■ 集中しやすい紙面風デザイン

デザインは、雑誌や新聞のパズル欄をイメージした紙面風デザイン。
派手な演出を抑え、落ち着いたグラフィックで推理・思考に集中しやすいUIを採用しています。

操作はシンプルで、直感的に遊べるため、
大人向け・シニア向けの脳トレアプリとしてもおすすめです。


■ オフライン対応・隙間時間に最適

オフラインでも遊べる、完全無料（広告あり）の一人用パズルゲームです。
時間制限に追われることのないゲーム性と、オートセーブ対応のため、通勤・通学、休憩時間、待ち時間などの暇つぶしにも最適。

This application presents a collection of creature emoji cards arranged in a grid, each representing a different species from across the natural world. The gameplay follows a Simon Says style format where the system illuminates cards in a specific order during a preview phase, and you must replicate that exact sequence by tapping the correct cards in order. Before each round begins, all cards are revealed face-up with a visible countdown timer, giving you precious seconds to study their positions. The highlight phase then plays out, showing which cards to select and in what order. A single card may be highlighted multiple times within one sequence, requiring you to tap it repeatedly during your turn. Three difficulty tiers are available. Beginner mode offers four cards with extended preview time and slower highlight speed. Intermediate mode raises the count to six cards with moderate pacing. Advanced mode presents nine cards with rapid sequences that demand sharp focus. Each stage increases the length of the sequence, creating a progressively steeper challenge. You begin every game with three lives. An incorrect selection costs one life, but the sequence replays so you can attempt it again. Lose all three lives and the session ends. games.name: Fan Duel
games.description:
Fan Duel is a thrilling arcade puzzle experience that combines strategy, speed, and quick decision making into one intense gameplay loop. In Fan Duel, you must navigate a compact 9 by 9 maze and reach the glowing exit before time runs out. Every round in Fan Duel presents a newly generated layout, ensuring that each attempt feels fresh, unpredictable, and engaging.

The core challenge of Fan Duel lies not only in finding the correct path but also in avoiding a relentless red pursuer that moves after every step you take. This mechanic transforms Fan Duel into a tense chase where every move matters. The further you progress, the faster the pursuer becomes, forcing you to think ahead and act quickly to survive.

Fan Duel is designed to reward both speed and smart planning. Reaching the exit quickly grants time bonuses, allowing you to build a higher score and extend your run. At the same time, Fan Duel encourages careful movement, as reckless decisions can lead you straight into danger. Balancing risk and reward is the key to mastering Fan Duel.

You start each session in Fan Duel with three hearts, giving you limited chances to make mistakes. Losing all hearts ends your run, so every step should be calculated. This adds an extra layer of tension to Fan Duel, making each round feel meaningful and exciting. The more efficiently you move and escape, the longer you stay in the game.

One of the most engaging aspects of Fan Duel is its procedural maze generation. Every maze is guaranteed to have a valid path, but the layout constantly changes, ensuring that players cannot rely on memorization. This makes Fan Duel highly replayable and keeps the experience fresh no matter how many times you play.

Fan Duel also emphasizes progression and self improvement. With each completed round, the difficulty gradually increases, testing your reflexes and decision making skills. The game motivates players to beat their personal best and discover how many rounds they can survive in Fan Duel.

The controls in Fan Duel are simple and intuitive, allowing players to focus entirely on movement and strategy. Whether you prefer quick taps or more deliberate actions, Fan Duel adapts to your playstyle and keeps the gameplay smooth and responsive.

With its minimalist design, dynamic pacing, and constant tension, Fan Duel delivers an addictive experience that is easy to pick up but difficult to master. Every round feels like a new challenge, and every escape brings a sense of accomplishment.

games.name: Mythic Bouncer
games.description:
In **Mythic Bouncer**, the player finds themselves amidst ancient celestial temples, hovering high above the clouds. The hero wields a bronze shield adorned with Greek motifs—the very tool used to control the movement of a divine orb. The orb continuously ricochets off walls, the ceiling, and the hero's shield, hurtling toward the stone structures that must be destroyed. Each precise deflection alters the orb's trajectory and brings the player closer to the moment when the celestial expanse is finally cleared of these ancient edifices.

In **Mythic Bouncer**, everything revolves around the rhythm of the orb's movement and the precision of the player's reactions. The player maneuvers the shield from side to side, striving to prevent the orb from falling away. Should it slip past and vanish beyond the boundaries of the playing field, the attempt ends in the loss of a life. Thus, every bounce becomes a small test of mindfulness and control.

The stone buildings in **Mythic Bouncer** vary in size and durability. Smaller structures crumble quickly, while massive temples can withstand multiple impacts before shattering into pieces. With every hit, the stone blocks crack and gradually disintegrate, clearing the sky and earning points for the player. The more massive the building, the more challenging it is to destroy—and the more valuable the reward for a successful strike.

Occasionally, a golden artifact appears amidst the ruins. If the player manages to catch it with their shield, a rare and delightful event occurs in **Mythic Bouncer**: a second orb appears in the sky, and a lost life is restored. Now, two orbs move simultaneously along different trajectories, making the action even more dynamic and demanding the player's absolute concentration.

As the game of **Mythic Bouncer** progresses, the celestial space is gradually cleared of temples, and the pace of movement becomes increasingly rapid and precise. A mechanic that appears simple at first glance transforms into a meditative yet tense test of reflexes, where every bounce can prove decisive. Reflect the celestial orb with your shield and destroy ancient temples.

🃏 How to Play
The rules stay true to the Myanmar traditions you know and love:

The Deck: Played with a standard 52-card deck.

The Deal: Every player starts with 2 cards.

The Score: Your score is the remainder of the sum of your cards divided by 10.

Example: If you have a 7 and an 8 (Total = 15), your score is 5.

The "Koe" (9) or "Eight": If your initial two cards total 8 or 9, it’s a showdown! Everyone reveals their cards, and the highest score wins the round.

The Draw: Feeling unlucky? If your score is lower than 4, you have the option to draw one additional card to boost your total.

games.name: 5D Chess
games.description:
5D Chess reimagines the classic game of chess by introducing time travel and parallel timelines as core gameplay mechanics. Instead of playing on a single board with a linear sequence of moves, players compete across multiple boards that exist at different moments in time and across alternate realities. The result is a strategic experience that goes far beyond traditional chess.

At its foundation, the game still follows the familiar rules of chess. Pieces move in the same ways they always have: bishops diagonally, rooks along ranks and files, knights in L-shaped jumps, and so on. However, players are no longer restricted to moving pieces only within the present moment of a single board. Pieces can travel backward or forward through time, interact with earlier positions, and even create entirely new timelines.

When a piece moves into the past, it creates a branching timeline that develops independently from the original board. This produces multiple parallel versions of the game that exist simultaneously. Each timeline evolves based on the moves played within it, allowing the game to expand dynamically as new timelines are created. Players must think not only about space on a chessboard but also about how their moves affect the structure of time itself.

The interface organizes boards along a visual timeline so players can clearly track how events unfold across dimensions. Each board represents a specific point in time within a particular timeline. As the game progresses, additional boards appear, forming a network of interconnected realities. Players must monitor threats, defenses, and opportunities across these timelines simultaneously.

Because of this structure, strategy becomes dramatically more complex. A move made in the present might be countered by sending a piece into the past to alter the position before that move ever happened. Alternatively, players can create new timelines to escape dangerous situations or launch attacks that originate from different moments in time. Planning several moves ahead now involves understanding how multiple timelines may evolve in parallel.

Victory is still achieved through checkmate, but the concept expands significantly. Your king must remain safe across all active timelines while you attempt to trap your opponent’s king somewhere within the multiverse. This means that defensive play requires managing threats across many boards at once, while offensive strategies may involve coordinating attacks that originate from different timelines.

The result is a game that rewards deep planning, pattern recognition, and creative problem solving. Players who enjoy complex strategy games will find that 5D Chess offers a unique challenge that continually evolves as new timelines appear.

Features include:

Traditional chess mechanics combined with time-travel gameplay
Parallel timelines that branch when pieces move into the past
Multiple boards representing different moments in time
A clear timeline visualization system for tracking alternate realities
Complex strategic interactions across timelines and boards
Matches that evolve dynamically as new timelines form
A challenging experience for players who enjoy deep strategic thinking

Every match of 5D Chess becomes its own multiverse puzzle. Instead of calculating moves only along a single board, players must understand how their actions ripple through time and across alternate realities. A single decision can create new possibilities, new threats, and entirely new timelines that reshape the game.

Whether you are a long-time chess player or someone interested in unusual strategy games, 5D Chess offers a distinctive experience that expands the boundaries of what chess can be. Play chess across time and parallel timelines in the multiverse

games.name: Detective Me: Imposter Game
games.description:
Detective Me is a fun and entertaining game that is great for social gatherings. In multiplayer (online) mode, you can play with friends from different phones.
One player clicks "Create Game" and enters his name. A 6-digit code is generated. The other players click "Join Game", enter their name, game code, and join the game. When everyone joins, the host starts the game. By clicking "See Word", the program shows a word from the selected word list. Everyone sees the same word, except for one person, who sees "Imposter" instead of the word. During the game, you can make notes (visible only to you) that will help you navigate more easily when voting at the end. The game can be played in 2 ways: question and answer and one word/phrase at a time (as you wish). In the case of question and answer, the players take turns asking each other questions to try to find out who the imposter is, and the imposter tries to guess the word during the question and answer. During the question and answer, the player must try to answer the question given to him as accurately as possible so that the imposter cannot guess the word from his answer, but the other players understand the content of the answer. The questions are asked in turn, each player answers the question given to him and asks a question to whom he would like to, except for the person who asked him the last question.
It is forbidden to lie when answering the question. You must always answer correctly. You can answer approximately, not very specifically, but you cannot lie.
It is forbidden to ask similar questions - "What is the first letter of the word", "How many letters does the word consist of", etc. In the case of a word/phrase, the players take turns saying one word/phrase that is associated with the given word. When the time is up, voting begins
In the voting phase, you choose a suspicious player.
When everyone has voted, the host's "View Results" button becomes active.
The Results page displays:

who received how many votes,
who voted against whom.
If there is a player with the most votes, they leave the game
After the results, the host can:
continue the game, if they still want to continue finding the imposter
start a new game with the same word list
end the game
Additional information notes
Once the game has started, new players cannot join.
If a player leaves or is removed, they no longer participate in the current game.
If the application has been closed, it is possible to reconnect to the previous game (if the game is still active). Find the imposter, play in multiplayer mode.

- Tap on domino tiles to match them
- Clear all dominoes to complete the level

- Clever category-based matching mechanics

- Perfect balance of challenge and calm
- Ideal levels for daily mental exercise
